title: Concept: SVG animate element rewriting a link target
description: An animate element that targets the href attribute in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Animation can change a link's destination after the page has been reviewed, so a reader who inspects the visible markup still follows a different URL when clicking.
applicability: Deployments that render an animate element that targets the href attribute into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Animation can change a link's destination after the page has been reviewed, so a reader who inspects the visible markup still follows a different URL when clicking.
